content: For the customer with the largest outstanding reserve on a single open claim, which policies do they hold?

name: query_salesforce
query_salesforce

content:
The customer is [Copperfield Property Management](/lightning/r/001aj000040t3d1AAA/view). Their open claim [00002221](/lightning/r/500aj00003jLAOhAAO/view) has the largest outstanding reserve on any single open claim: **$490,000**.

They have three policies. All are active and all expire on 7 Jan 2027:

| Policy | Line | Annual Premium |
|---|---|---|
| [ANT-CP-205061](/lightning/r/a00aj00003jKdyPAAS/view) | Commercial Property | $118,000 |
| [ANT-GL-205078](/lightning/r/a00aj00003jKdyQAAS/view) | General Liability | $31,200 |
| [ANT-UM-205095](/lightning/r/a00aj00003jKdyRAAS/view) | Umbrella | $12,400 |

Together they come to **$161,600** in annual premium.
